$comment: The toolchain the CI legs are pinned to, in one place. tools/ci/check_toolchain_versions.py fails when a workflow or an install script carries a different value (docs/ci.md). msvc_toolset is what windows-2025 carries and has no other home. The vcpkg baseline stays in vcpkg.json. cmake is the newest version that lukka/get-cmake v4.3.4 has in its catalog, which is what its latest resolved to before the version was pinned.
